text:
maya (oncall): :rotating_light: paging - multiple p99 spikes across streaming endpoints in us-west-2, alerted by SLO watch. p95 ~ 300ms (ok) but p99 jumping to ~3.2s and streaming stalls reported by customers.
inc_bot: Incident created: INCIDENT-4123456789 - Latency spike / streaming stalls - assigned to oncall. Severity: Sev2.
maya (oncall): I'm taking it. Initial checks - control plane healthy, primary autoscaling OK. Sounds like tail stalls. Anyone seeing GPU node alerts?
sam (eng-sre): I'm seeing node thermal warnings on accel-cluster-19 in us-west-2, several nodes with repeated ECC correctable errors and then elevated power-limit events. Kernel logs show nvml reports TLIMIT and ECC_CORRECTABLE.
liam (runtime): Confirmed from runtime traces: KV cache miss latencies spike correlated with node-level requeues. Affected pods show high GPU utilization followed by long stalls ~1.5-2s then resume. Persistent across multiple hosts.
jordan (eng-ml): Which model family? Are these long-context streams? Could be sequence length causing throttles.
liam (runtime): Mostly 4096 seq lengths on matrix-13 models running in int8. Streaming sessions show stall at token boundary during large attention windows.
sasha (product): Customer impact: two enterprise customers reported degraded chat UX and timeouts on long streaming sessions. Support is triaging.
anita (support): I've opened tickets INC-9002 and INC-9003 and notified account teams. ETA on mitigation? Customers are seeing timeouts after 10s.
maya (oncall): Immediate mitigation options: 1) route traffic away from affected nodes, 2) reduce batch sizes or seq length cap at edge, 3) fallback to slightly smaller model variant, 4) drain and reboot problematic GPUs. Thoughts?
sam (eng-sre): We should avoid blunt reboots until we confirm root cause. Suggest marking nodes in degraded state and redirect new sessions to warm pool using routing policy. I'll start cordon/drain on flagged hosts.
liam (runtime): I'll push a routing rule: prefer pool-within-region: warm-2 and enable immediate fallback policy for streaming endpoints to a compatible 13B-quantized variant. That reduces memory pressure and KV usage.
jordan (eng-ml): Fallback to the 13B-q4 variant will increase p95 slightly but stabilizes p99. Also recommend we temporarily disable continuous batching for these sessions to reduce peak GPU power draw.
sam (eng-sre): Implementing node mark-degraded tag now and initiating cordon on accel-cluster-19-node-07/08/09. Starting reroute.
deploy-bot: Routed 18 streams away from accel-cluster-19-node-07 in 12s.
liam (runtime): Routing rule applied. Also turned on session-level seq-length cap of 2048 for streaming endpoints as emergency throttle.
anita (support): Notifying customers: "We've applied routing and temporary session caps to reduce stalls. Expect reduced stalls within minutes; minor quality tradeoffs possible."
sasha (product): Good - flag the outreach and any compensation ask. Keep me in the loop.
maya (oncall): Observability: p99 dropped from 3.2s to ~650ms within 2 minutes of reroute. Streaming stall reports decreased. Still seeing sporadic ECC correctable bursts on two nodes.
sam (eng-sre): Logs show thermal excursions coincident with power capping from host BIOS on two nodes. Likely thermal throttling triggered by recent rack cooling issue. Eng-infra notified.
jordan (eng-ml): For long-term, we should add model-aware routing: avoid packing heavy long-seq streams onto same node. Also pre-warm quantized variants.
liam (runtime): Taking follow-up actions: 1) keep nodes cordoned and drain remaining sessions, 2) enable auto-fallback for streaming to 13B-q4 for this cohort for 2 hours, 3) reduce max batch size by 30% cluster-wide for streaming endpoints in us-west-2.
sam (eng-sre): Eng-infra confirms a cooling loop pressure drop in rack 19 - they will swap fans and rebalance airflow; hardware team will run memtest and nvml diagnostics on drained nodes.
manually_note: Reaction :thumbsup: from eng-infra (inline).
anita (support): Customers acknowledge the update. One customer wants their sessions pinned to dedicated capacity; opening sales escalation.
sasha (product): Post-incident follow-up: capture telemetry of sequence length distribution causing worst stalls, add SLO alert refinement for streaming p99 > 1s sustained >5m, and review routing fallback thresholds.
maya (oncall): Handoff: I'm handing to sam and liam for remediation and infra coordination for the next 3 hours. I'll monitor but stepping off primary.
sam (eng-sre): Acknowledged takeover. I will coordinate hardware swap and final health checks.
liam (runtime): I will monitor KV cache hit/miss, batching metrics, and keep the fallback active until nodes pass diagnostics. Plan to scale warm pool by +3 nodes to absorb load.
jordan (eng-ml): Will prepare a short regression test to ensure fallback preserves output quality and measure token-cost delta.
sam (eng-sre): Degraded nodes are out of rotation and undergoing validation. nvml logs show ECC correctable counts stabilized after thermal mitigation in one node, second node still reports intermittent power-limit events. Pending hardware replacement for the second node.
maya (oncall): Status update for timeline: 00:00 - alert; 00:03 - routing/fallback applied; 00:05 - p99 improved to ~650ms; 00:18 - nodes cordoned and draining; 00:40 - infra swapping fans; 01:15 - follow-up diagnostics and postmortem to be scheduled.
anita (support): Closing customer-facing incident notes; will send an email with mitigation summary and ETA for hardware fix.
sasha (product): Add to roadmap: better scheduling heuristics for long-seq workloads and a per-customer routing SLA option.
liam (runtime): I'll create an eval to simulate 4096 seq streaming under throttled-power conditions to reproduce and harden fallback triggers.
sam (eng-sre): After swap, we'll run burn-in for 2 hours before returning nodes to rotation.
maya (oncall): Thanks team. Leaving incident channel open for follow-ups. Please add any logs/traces to INCIDENT-4123456789 thread in the incident tracker.
inc_bot: Incident status updated to Mitigated - monitoring. Severity: Sev2 -> Postmortem review scheduled.
